tasks.request: Our miniflux.conf was copied from a shell env file, so values are wrapped in quotes, like DATABASE_URL="postgres://..." or LOG_LEVEL="debug". Miniflux keeps the quotes as part of the value (LOG_LEVEL is even rejected), so please strip a matching pair of surrounding single or double quotes from values in the config file.
tasks.referenceChange: internal/config/parser.go: parseFileContent now splits each line on the first '=' and passes the trimmed value through a new unquoteValue helper that removes one matching pair of surrounding " or ' quotes.
tasks.notes: Test parses a temp file with NewConfigParser().ParseFile and checks the existing accessors DatabaseURL, AdminUsername, LogLevel, HTTPClientUserAgent. LOG_LEVEL has a choice validator, so quotes must be removed before validation (stripping in parseFileContent or parseLines both work). Stripping quotes for environment variables too is acceptable; not tested.

tasks.request: Our scripts call the API with things like ?update_content=yes or ?globally_visible=no, and Miniflux silently ignores those values and uses the default. Please accept yes/no and on/off (any case) for boolean query parameters, the same as true/false.
tasks.referenceChange: internal/http/request/params.go: QueryBoolParam checks strings.ToLower(value) for yes/on (true) and no/off (false) before falling back to strconv.ParseBool.
tasks.notes: Test calls the existing exported helper QueryBoolParam (the single place all handlers parse bool query params), since the API handlers need a database. Unknown values ('maybe') must still return the default; existing TestQueryBoolParam ('wat' -> default) keeps passing.

tasks.request: Image attachments whose URL ends in .webp or .avif and that have no MIME type aren't treated as images, so they don't show up like .jpg/.png ones do. Please recognize .webp and .avif as images too.
tasks.referenceChange: internal/model/enclosure.go: Enclosure.IsImage also returns true for URLs ending in .webp or .avif (URL is already lower-cased).
tasks.notes: Tests the exported Enclosure.IsImage method with empty MimeType. Upper-case extension must work (existing code lower-cases the URL). .mp3/.pdf must stay non-images.

tasks.request: In my entry filter rules, EntryDate=max-age:7d works but max-age:2w does nothing. Please support weeks (w) in max-age, like days.
tasks.referenceChange: internal/reader/filter/filter.go: parseDuration handles a 'w' suffix (integer weeks * 7 * 24h) before falling back to time.ParseDuration.
tasks.notes: Test goes through exported ParseRules + IsBlockedEntry with entries 15 days (blocked) and 10 days (kept) old for max-age:2w, plus a 7d control. The rule validator (internal/validator/filter.go) only checks regex syntax, so no second file is needed.
